requested_workflow: State the new capability and compare precise primary prior work and concrete simple controls first.
Explore 2-3 distinct mechanisms concurrently; derive counterexamples and small models before RTL.
Build RTL only for a candidate with a specified discriminating capability or cost/performance point.

parallel_design_seats.question: Late-authorized source read sharing with bounded storage and immutable transaction obligations
Convert early translation into actual data progress under committed write order
Joint translation locality and consumer completion under a finite live-data budget

evidence_workers: Three actual concurrent DeepSeek flash/high calls, one per direction. Full raw JSON and complete answer text preserved; workers did not browse, execute commands or edit files.
required_candidate_card: Real trigger/scenario, separately marked as measured, sourced or constructed
Visible information and complete permission/job/epoch/lifetime contract
Specific rule, state, scheduling action and non-retractable transaction constraints
Closest exact prior mechanism with reading scope; concrete feasible simple controls
One discriminating derivation/counterexample/model and explicit falsifier
Complete resource cost including feedback, storage, ports, target writes and consumer completion
Decision to stop, refine the model or enter a minimal RTL test
acceptance_policy: No automatic novelty from working RTL, lower traffic, a new name or model agreement. No automatic rejection from a broad analogous idea or a hypothetical control that simply copies the proposal. Exact coverage or a complete feasible countercontrol is required. Narrow causal/conditional language for independent contribution.
this_stage_execution_scope: Research design, targeted source/primary reading, hand derivations and evidence dispatch only. No new DUT/model runs, RTL builds, production RTL/Linux changes, BIT, Mac/JTAG, SD or board work.
